1 /* 2 * Copyright 2016-2017 the original author or authors. 3 * 4 * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License"); 5 * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License. 6 * You may obtain a copy of the License at 7 * 8 * http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 9 * 10 * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software 11 * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, 12 * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. 13 * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and 14 * limitations under the License. 15 */ 16 17 package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.controller.v1; 18 19 import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.mapper.LuhnCheckDigit; 20 21 /** 22 * Composes an owner's unified member id. Kept apart from {@link OwnerRestControllerV1} so the request 23 * handler stays focused on orchestration while the rule for how a member id is composed lives in one 24 * place, alongside the other owner-field derivations. The controller supplies the region (derived from 25 * the owner's postcode), the two-digit fiscal year and the identity fields; this helper assembles the id. 26 * 27 *

The id is formatted {@code }: REGION is the owner's region code (derived 28 * from the postcode), FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the owner's registration date, HASH8 is the 29 * first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's normalized telephone 30 * followed by its last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of 31 * {@code } (for example {@code NSW261A2B3C4D3}). 32 */ 33 final class MemberId { 34 35 /** Number of upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest that form the HASH8 segment. */ 36 private static final int HASH_LENGTH = 8; 37 38 private MemberId() { 39 } 40 41 /** 42 * Assembles the member id for an owner from its region, fiscal year and identity fields. The HASH8 43 * segment is the first eight upper-case hex characters of {@code SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + 44 * lastName)}, and the trailing CHK is the Luhn check digit over the digits of the assembled 45 * {@code }. 46 * 47 * @param region the owner's region code, forming the REGION segment 48 * @param fiscalYearTwoDigit the two-digit fiscal year of the owner's registration date (0-99) 49 * @param normalizedTelephone the owner's already-normalized telephone, hashed with the last name 50 * @param lastName the owner's last name, hashed with the normalized telephone 51 * @return the assembled member id 52 */ 53 static String forRegionYearAndIdentity(String region, int fiscalYearTwoDigit, 54 String normalizedTelephone, String lastName) { 55 String base = region + String.format("%02d", fiscalYearTwoDigit) + hash8(normalizedTelephone, lastName); 56 return base + LuhnCheckDigit.forDigits(base); 57 } 58 59 /** 60 * Computes the HASH8 segment of an owner's member id: the first {@value #HASH_LENGTH} upper-case hex 61 * characters of {@code SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)}. Exposed on its own, rather than only 62 * being inlined into {@link #forRegionYearAndIdentity}, so the single definition of the identity hash 63 * is reused wherever the id's hash segment is needed rather than being re-derived. 64 * 65 * @param normalizedTelephone the owner's already-normalized telephone, hashed with the last name 66 * @param lastName the owner's last name, hashed with the normalized telephone 67 * @return the HASH8 segment, as {@value #HASH_LENGTH} upper-case hex characters 68 */ 69 static String hash8(String normalizedTelephone, String lastName) { 70 return Sha256.hex(normalizedTelephone + lastName).substring(0, HASH_LENGTH).toUpperCase(); 71 } 72 73 } 74
